image_description: A medium shot of a smiling man in sunglasses and a cap holding a large sturgeon fish horizontally. The fish is the primary subject, displaying its elongated body, pointed snout, and tail. In the background, there is a body of water, trees, and part of a boat structure with fishing rods.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The side profile clearly shows the characteristic elongated snout and the mouth positioned on the underside (ventral) of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct, dangling barbels are visible hanging from the snout area in front of the mouth.
The snout tapers to a clear point at the anterior end of the fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish has a long, torpedo-shaped body consistent with the fusiform description, spanning the width of the holder's arms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the lateral line and dorsal ridge, rather than typical fish scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish appears darker (grayish-brown) while the belly area held by the man is significantly lighter/white, matching the counter-shading description.
The tail fin is clearly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe being larger and extending further than the lower lobe, a defining trait of sturgeons.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike fish genera.
To verify the integrity of the scutes and ensure no fusion artifacts between the fish and the holder's hands.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative noise.
To ensure the complex rigging in the background maintains valid 3D geometry and doesn't show melting artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the scutes; AI often smears these into generic scales. Verify the barbel count is exactly four, as AI frequently generates extra or fused whiskers. Check the tail for structural plausibility.
